raw_segments.text: Two young ladies appeared before me, one very tall, almost as tall as Miss Ingram, very thin
too, with a sallow face and severe mean.
There was something ascetic in her look, which was augmented by the extreme plainness of
a straight-skirted, black, stuffed dress, a starched linen collar, hair combed away
from the temples, and the nun-like ornament of a string of ebony beads and a crucifix.
This I felt sure was Eliza, though I could trace little resemblance to her former self
in that elongated and colorless visage.
